media_clips.title: Discovery: Surface Answer se Real Problem tak kaise jaayein
media_clips.reason: Dipak's lesson for Discovery & Deep Understanding, the skill this coaching focuses on. It addresses a judgment gap (recognising the moment), the likely reason here.
takeaways: Ask for the last concrete example.
Reflect the answer before going deeper.
media_clips.transcript_excerpt: Ab “Sales nahi aa rahi” example use karo. Prospect: “Sir sales nahi aa rahi.” “Main is point par ye decide nahi karunga ki problem kya hai. Main pehle statement ko specific banaunga.” “Jab aap bol rahe ho sales nahi aa rahi, pehle better thi aur recently decline hui hai, ya conversion hamesha se low raha hai?” Prospect: “Pehle achhi thi, last 4 months se gir gayi.” Ab aapke paas new context hai. “Okay. Aur leads bhi kam hui hain ya leads roughly same aa rahi hain?”
